rv.q: Playwright Vozella weaves several themes throughout her intelligent, incisive script–art vs. life, originality vs. artifice, fidelity vs. betrayal, dishonesty vs. transparency, and more–all of which dangle at the play's end without clear conclusion, which might very well be the point of this thought-provoking ride.
While Machine Learning is not nearly as fascinating as that unsettling little play, it does give me a clear sense of the stories that make Little Engine chug.
